feed.title: Track Awesome Privacy Updates Daily
feed.subtitle: Awesome Privacy - A curated list of services and alternatives that respect your privacy because PRIVACY MATTERS.

entry.title: Awesome Privacy Updates on Nov 02, 2026
entry.content:
Centralized

  • Signal - Messenger with end-to-end encryption for everything by default, run by a nonprofit that keeps almost no user data. AGPL-3.0
  • Threema - Paid messenger from Switzerland that works without a phone number or email. AGPL-3.0

Third-Party owned

  • Posteo - Ad-free email from Germany, funded only by its users, with optional encrypted storage and sign-up and payment that need no personal details.

Browser Addons / Anti-tracking

  • uBlock Origin (⭐69k) - Light, efficient ad and tracker blocker, in full only on Firefox since Chrome dropped Manifest V2 extensions. Browser · GPL-3.0

Cloud Storage / Useful Tools

  • Filen - End-to-end encrypted cloud storage from Germany, with desktop, mobile and web clients you can inspect.

Other useful tools / Useful Tools

  • git-annex - Manages and syncs large files with git without storing their contents in git, across drives and many cloud and offline backends.

Shazam alternative clients / Deezer alternative clients

  • Audile (⭐1.4k) - Music recognition app that queries Shazam, AudD or ACRCloud and keeps your history on the device. Android · GPL-3.0

Desktop / Deezer alternative clients

  • qView (⭐3.7k) - Minimal, fast image viewer that shows just the image with no clutter. Linux · macOS · Windows · GPL-3.0

Mario Kart / Deezer alternative clients

  • Dr. Robotnik's Ring Racers - Technical kart racer built on the Sonic Robo Blast 2 engine, the sequel to SRB2Kart. GPL-2.0

Minecraft / Deezer alternative clients

  • Cubyz (⭐3.7k) - Voxel sandbox game with far view distances, 3D chunks and procedural crafting. GPL-3.0

Android SMS / Plugins for Minecraft

  • QUIK (⭐2.9k) - SMS and MMS app, a maintained fork of QKSMS. Android · GPL-3.0

Android / Android-Based

  • LineageOS for microG - LineageOS builds that ship microG instead of Google Play Services, with F-Droid included.

IDEs / Other OS

  • GNU Emacs - Extensible, self-documenting editor from the GNU Project that you can shape into a full IDE.

Automation / Apps and services

  • Huginn (⭐50k) - Self-hosted agents that watch websites, feeds and APIs and act for you, an alternative to IFTTT and Zapier. self-host · MIT

entry.title: Awesome Privacy Updates on Sep 30, 2026
entry.content:
Third-Party owned

  • mailbox.org - Paid email, calendar and office suite from Germany, with built-in PGP encryption and no ads.

Email verification required, accepting monero / Desktop

  • Onlinesim - Temporary virtual numbers for receiving verification codes. ⚠️ website trackers

Teamworking Tools / Desktop

  • Stoat - Discord-like chat platform with servers and channels, which you can host yourself, formerly Revolt. self-host

YouTube / YouTube alternative frontends (web-based)

  • ViewTube (⭐1.5k) - YouTube frontend without ads or tracking, with its own accounts, subscriptions and SponsorBlock. AGPL-3.0

Commenting Engines / Privacy respecting Twitch clients

  • Comentario - Small self-hosted comment engine that adds discussions to static pages. self-host · MIT
  • Disgus (⭐54) - Embeddable comments for your website, stored on Nostr instead of a company's servers. GPL-2.0
  • Giscus - Comments stored in GitHub Discussions, with no database, ads or tracking; readers need a GitHub account to post. MIT
  • Remark42 - Lightweight self-hosted comment engine that doesn't track your readers. self-host · MIT

VPNs / Privacy respecting Twitch clients

  • nadanada - Pay-per-use WireGuard VPN with no account, payable in Bitcoin, Monero and other cryptocurrencies, formerly LNVPN.

Desktop / Privacy respecting Twitch clients

  • Firefox - Independent browser from Mozilla that needs some hardening for strong privacy. ⚠️ website trackers ⚠️ telemetry opt-out
    • LibreWolf - Firefox fork with telemetry removed, stricter defaults and uBlock Origin built in. Linux · macOS · Windows

Domains & Hosting / Useful Tools

  • 1984 Hosting - Icelandic hosting and domain registrar focused on civil liberties, with anonymous signup and Monero payment.

Analytics / Useful Tools

  • Rybbit - Cookie-free web analytics, as a hosted service or on your own server. AGPL-3.0

Routers / Useful Tools

  • IPFire - Hardened Linux firewall distribution with intrusion prevention and a web interface.
  • OpenWrt - Linux firmware that replaces the stock software on hundreds of consumer routers and keeps them updated.
  • OPNsense - FreeBSD-based firewall and router for dedicated hardware or a spare PC. ⚠️ website trackers BSD-2-Clause

Password Managers / Useful Tools

  • AliasVault - End-to-end encrypted password manager with a built-in email alias server. self-host · AGPL-3.0

Pastebin and Secret Sharing / Useful Tools

  • crypt.fyi - Self-destructing secret sharing with end-to-end encryption, from the web, the command line or a browser extension.

Whistleblowing / Useful Tools

  • GlobaLeaks - Whistleblowing platform for organisations, newsrooms and activists, reachable over Tor. self-host · AGPL-3.0
  • SecureDrop - Submission system that lets newsrooms receive documents from anonymous sources over Tor. self-host

Notes and Tasks / Useful Tools

  • AppFlowy - Notion alternative for docs, wikis and task boards that you can run locally or host yourself. ⚠️ website trackers AGPL-3.0
  • Standard Notes - End-to-end encrypted notes app that syncs across all your devices. AGPL-3.0 · F-Droid
  • Trilium Notes (⭐38k) - Hierarchical personal knowledge base you can sync through your own server, with optional encryption for individual notes. self-host · AGPL-3.0

Bookmarking / Useful Tools

  • 42links - Minimalist self-hosted bookmark storage. self-host
  • Floccus - Syncs your bookmarks across browsers and devices through your own Nextcloud, WebDAV or Git server. MPL-2.0 · F-Droid
  • Grimoire (⭐2.9k) - Self-hosted bookmark manager that extracts and keeps the readable content of what you save. self-host · MIT
  • LinkAce (⭐3.3k) - Self-hosted bookmark archive that monitors and organizes your saved links. self-host · GPL-3.0
  • LinkDing (⭐11k) - Minimal, fast self-hosted bookmark manager that is easy to run with Docker. self-host · MIT
  • Linkwarden - Self-hosted bookmark manager that saves and archives full copies of the pages you collect. self-host · AGPL-3.0
  • Readeck - Single-binary self-hosted read-it-later app that saves articles for offline reading. self-host
  • Shiori (⭐12k) - Self-hosted bookmark manager written in Go, usable from the command line or a web interface. self-host · MIT
  • Wallabag - Read-it-later server you can host yourself, or use through a paid hosted service. self-host · MIT · F-Droid

Forms / Useful Tools

  • TypeBot - Builder for conversational, chat-style forms that you can host yourself. ⚠️ source-available self-host

Databases / Useful Tools

  • Supabase - Postgres-based Firebase alternative with auth, storage and realtime APIs, though self-hosting (⭐114k) is limited (⭐114k). self-host · Apache-2.0

Third-party / Deezer alternative clients

  • Ente - End-to-end encrypted photo and video backup whose cryptography was independently audited. ⚠️ website trackers self-host · AGPL-3.0

Creator Tools / Deezer alternative clients

  • Screenity - Screen recorder and annotation tool for Chrome that keeps your videos on your device, with no sign-in. Browser · GPL-3.0

Minecraft / Plugins for Minecraft

  • FreedomChat (⭐232) - Server plugin that makes player chat unreportable while staying compatible with other plugins. GPL-3.0

Ebooks / Plugins for Minecraft

  • Calibre - Ebook manager with format conversion, metadata editing and a built-in reader, all offline. ⚠️ website trackers Linux · macOS · Windows · GPL-3.0

Android / Based on Linux

  • Nura - Alpine Linux tuned for phones and other devices, built to keep old hardware useful, formerly postmarketOS.

PC / MacOS / GNU/Linux

  • Fedora - Community distribution sponsored by Red Hat, with recent software on a six-month release cycle.
  • Kicksecure - Debian hardened by the Whonix developers, with security settings turned on by default.
  • secureblue - Hardened images built on Fedora Atomic Desktops, with security-focused defaults and a hardened browser. Apache-2.0
  • Whonix - Runs inside virtual machines and forces every connection through Tor, so apps can't leak your real IP.

Home Assistants / Other OS

  • Home Assistant - Home automation hub that runs on your own hardware and controls your devices locally, no cloud account needed. Apache-2.0

Version Control / Other OS

  • Radicle - Peer-to-peer code collaboration on Git, with repositories replicated across peers and no central server in control.

entry.title: Awesome Privacy Updates on Jul 04, 2026
entry.content:
Decentralized

  • DeltaChat - Messenger that runs over email, with end-to-end encryption and no phone number needed. GPL-3.0 · F-Droid
  • Jabber / XMPP (Protocol) - Long-standing open messaging standard with many servers and clients, and OMEMO for end-to-end encryption.
    • Conversations - XMPP client built for phones, with OMEMO encryption on by default. Android · F-Droid
    • Dino - Desktop XMPP client with OMEMO and OpenPGP end-to-end encryption. Linux · GPL-3.0
    • Gajim - Desktop XMPP client with OMEMO encryption. Linux · macOS · Windows · GPL-3.0
    • Snikket - Self-hosted XMPP service you set up with one command, with matching apps for your family or group. self-host · Apache-2.0 · F-Droid
  • Matrix (Protocol) - Open standard for federated chat and calls, with end-to-end encryption between clients. Apache-2.0
    • Cinny - Matrix client with a clean, minimal interface. AGPL-3.0
    • Element - The flagship Matrix client, with end-to-end encryption on by default for private chats. ⚠️ website trackers AGPL-3.0
  • Session - Messenger that needs no phone number and routes messages through an onion network of community-run nodes. GPL-3.0 · F-Droid
  • SimpleX Chat - Messenger with no user IDs at all, so its servers can't see who talks to whom. AGPL-3.0 · F-Droid

Self-Hosted

  • Stalwart - All-in-one mail and collaboration server in Rust covering SMTP, IMAP and JMAP, with two independent security audits. self-host

Fandom / Privacy respecting Twitch clients

  • BreezeWiki - Fandom frontend that strips ads, video and suggested content; also on several mirrors. self-host

VPNs / Privacy respecting Twitch clients

  • Amnezia VPN - VPN client that sets up a server on a VPS you rent, with protocols designed to get past censorship. self-host · GPL-3.0
  • Find more at kycnot.me (VPN Category) - Directory of VPN providers that don't ask for identity documents.

Desktop / Privacy respecting Twitch clients

  • Floorp - Firefox fork with telemetry disabled and extensive layout customization. Linux · macOS · Windows · MPL-2.0
  • Zen Browser - Firefox-based browser with vertical tabs and workspaces, keeping Firefox's tracking protection on by default. Linux · macOS · Windows · MPL-2.0

Browser Addons / Anti-tracking

  • ClearURLs - Strips tracking parameters from links and URLs. Browser · LGPL-3.0
  • Privacy Badger - EFF extension that learns to block trackers by watching them follow you across sites. Browser

Domains & Hosting / Useful Tools

  • Find more at kycnot.me (VPS Category) - Directory of VPS and hosting providers that don't ask for identity documents.

Link Shorteners / Useful Tools

  • Shlink - Self-hosted shortener that keeps its click statistics on your own server. self-host · MIT

Office / Useful Tools

  • Grist - Spreadsheet and database hybrid you can host yourself, as an Airtable alternative. ⚠️ website trackers self-host · Apache-2.0

Databases / Useful Tools

  • Baserow - Self-hosted no-code database and spreadsheet, as an Airtable alternative. ⚠️ website trackers self-host
  • TrailBase - Single-executable Firebase alternative built on Rust and SQLite, with REST and realtime APIs, auth and an admin UI. self-host · OSL-3.0

Desktop / Deezer alternative clients

  • RapidRAW (⭐11k) - Lightweight, GPU-accelerated non-destructive raw editor, a Lightroom alternative. AGPL-3.0
  • RawTherapee - Offline raw photo developer that pairs well with darktable as a Lightroom alternative. Linux · macOS · Windows · GPL-3.0

Remote Access and Control / Other OS

  • Apache Guacamole - Self-hosted gateway that gives you RDP, VNC and SSH access from a browser, with no client to install. self-host · Apache-2.0
  • Sunshine + Moonlight - Low-latency desktop and game streaming, with Sunshine on the host and Moonlight clients connecting to it. ⚠️ website trackers self-host · GPL-3.0

ChatGPT / Other OS

  • Open WebUI - Self-hosted ChatGPT-style web interface for Ollama and other local or OpenAI-compatible models. ⚠️ source-available ⚠️ website trackers self-host

AI Coding / Other OS

  • Aider - Terminal pair programmer that edits code in your local git repository with the model you choose. CLI · Apache-2.0

Text to Speech / Other OS

  • Chatterbox (⭐28k) - Text-to-speech model with voice cloning that runs entirely on your own machine. MIT
  • Piper (⭐6.1k) - Fast local neural text-to-speech that runs well even on a Raspberry Pi. GPL-3.0

Image Generation / Apps and services

  • SwarmUI (⭐4.7k) - Local web interface for Stable Diffusion and other image models, running on a ComfyUI backend. MIT

Wallets / Apps and services

  • Cake Wallet - Non-custodial wallet for Monero, Bitcoin and other coins. MIT
  • Feather Wallet - Lightweight Monero desktop wallet with built-in Tor and coin control. Desktop · BSD-3-Clause

Payment Processors / Apps and services

  • BTCPay Server - Self-hosted, non-custodial processor for accepting Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies without a middleman. self-host · MIT

Where to use Monero and Bitcoin / Apps and services

  • kycnot.me - Directory of exchanges, payment processors and other services that don't require identity verification (KYC). ⚠️ source-available

Budget Management / Apps and services

  • Wallos - Self-hosted tracker for subscriptions and recurring expenses, with renewal reminders. self-host · GPL-3.0
